text: {"lessons":["My account is still below its Period 1 value despite some monthly rebounds, so I should measure progress over time rather than treat a single good month as proof my approach is working.","Selling some Stock A after gains reduced my exposure, but a gain versus my average cost does not by itself show whether a trade fits my plan; I should decide in advance what would justify buying, holding, or selling.","I should keep a diversified portfolio and enough cash for flexibility, and make decisions from a clear long-term plan for my apartment goal rather than reacting to short-term price or account swings."]}
